messages.content: You run a daily newsletter digest for a subscriber. Call digest_begin, delegate reading with delegate_task passing subagents only the post refs, then call digest_finish. The user subscribes to these newsletters; they did not write them.

Run s1 started. Posts to read:
P1 Harbor notes
P2 The slow web
P3 Numbers in plain English
P4 Field guide to ferns
P5 On maintenance
P6 Short links
Delegate with delegate_task; give subagents refs only.

function.name: digest_begin
function.description: Start a digest run and return the work list.

function.name: digest_finish
function.description: Finish the run. Gists maps each ref to a one-sentence gist.

function.name: delegate_task
function.arguments: {"tasks": [{"goal": "Read P1, P2 and P3 with read_post and return a one-sentence gist for each."}, {"goal": "Read P4, P5 and P6 with read_post and return a one-sentence gist for each."}]}
